name: Timestamp semantics: created, updated, read
description:
updated bumps only on summary/body/when/claims edits, not on anchor-hint fixes or read.
read is day-granular, written only when the date changes, and only by real reads (show, hook full-body injection), not list/find/index.
Merge rule: later timestamp wins; validate repairs leftover conflicts (optional git merge driver).
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged c45e882. Timestamps.Stamp(previous, current, now): created on new items; updated bumps on kind/summary/body/when changes (for anchors, a change to the line alone is ignored); returns the same instance when nothing changed. DocsStore.Save/SaveRepo stamp against the file on disk and return the stamped value. MarkRead is day-granular and never touches updated. StampHandEdits(rev=HEAD) compares against git show; ResolveConflicts() merges per entry (the later updated wins; read and created are merged separately; deletions are only detected with diff3 markers; config.yaml is never merged). Commands: docs touch [target] (bump updated, or stamp hand edits when no target is given) and docs merge-driver. #28 --fix: ResolveConflicts before Load, then StampHandEdits. #31: fall back to created when read is null. When claims (#36) land, add them to SameContent.
